description_en: Detaches Application Load Balancer (ALB) server groups from a scaling group. When you call the DetachAlbServerGroups operation, you can specify the scaling group ID, ALB server group ID, and port used by Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances in the desired ALB server group to detach one or more ALB server groups from your scaling group
description_zh: 调用DetachAlbServerGroups，并可以指定伸缩组的ID、ALB 服务器组的ID、ALB 服务器组中 ECS 实例使用的端口号等参数，实现从伸缩组中移出一个或多个ALB服务器组
kebab_example: aliyun ess detach-alb-server-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --alb-server-groups AlbServerGroupId=sgp-ddwb0y0g6y9bjm0000 Port=22 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachAlbServerGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group. Examples: cn-hangzhou and cn-shanghai
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove the existing Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances from the Application Load Balancer (ALB) server group marked for detachment. Valid values:

true: removes the existing ECS instances from the ALB server group and returns the value of `ScalingActivityId`. You can query the value of ScalingActivityId to check whether the existing ECS instances are removed from the ALB server group.
false: does not remove the existing ECS instances from the ALB server group.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否从待移出ALB服务器组中移出已有的ECS实例。取值范围：

true：移出，并返回`ScalingActivityId`，您可以通过查看该伸缩活动ID来确定已有实例是否移出成功。

false：不移出。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_detach

fields.help_en: The ID of the ALB server group
fields.name: alb_server_group_id

fields.help_en: The port number used by the ECS instances in the ALB server group
fields.help_zh: ALB服务器组中ECS实例使用的端口号
fields.name: port

parameters.help_en: Details of the ALB server groups
parameters.help_zh: ALB服务器组的相关信息集合
parameters.name: alb_server_groups

ScalingActivityId.description_en: The ID of the scaling activity during which the ALB server group is detached from the scaling group and the existing ECS instances are removed from the ALB server group. This parameter has a return value only if you set `ForceDetach` to `true`
ScalingActivityId.description_zh: 移出ALB服务器组，并移出该ALB服务器组内的ECS实例时，对应伸缩活动的ID。仅当`ForceDetach`取值为`true`时，返回该参数
